issues.detail: The Hebrew 'קְרָעִים' means 'pieces' or 'torn pieces' (of a garment), not '破布' (rags) or '杖' (staffs/rods). The Chinese renders the same word differently in two places ('破布' and '杖'), and '杖' is an addition/incorrect rendering not present in the Hebrew. The Hebrew says 'ten pieces' (of the garment), not 'ten staffs'.
